Seychelles vs Gambia: Watch Live Stream Online - World Cup 2026 Qualifier 14.10.2025

Join us for the live broadcast of a 2026 FIFA World Cup African zone qualification match, featuring Seychelles against Gambia. This encounter between the group's underdog and a mid-table side, both with no chance of qualifying, will take place at the Cote d'Or National Sports Complex.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 14, 2025, 13:00 UTC (16:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

The Seychelles national team is one of the weakest on the continent and currently sits at the bottom of Group F with zero points. The team has lost all of its matches in the current qualifying campaign, demonstrating disastrous defensive play with 46 goals conceded in nine games. Their attack is equally lackluster, having scored only 2 goals and failing to find the net in their last four matches. The team's overall winless streak stands at 20 games.

Gambia, having already been mathematically eliminated from qualifying, enters the match as the clear favorite. 'The Scorpions' are in fourth place in the group and have been playing high-scoring football, netting 20 goals in their last nine fixtures. In the reverse fixture, the Gambians thrashed Seychelles 5-1. Despite the lack of tournament motivation, the team will be aiming to end their qualifying campaign with a victory.

Head-to-Head History

The teams have met three times in their history. Gambia has won once, while Seychelles has two victories. However, their only World Cup qualifier encounter ended in a resounding 5-1 win for Gambia in June 2024.

Seychelles vs Gambia Prediction

Experts and bookmakers have no doubt about a victory for Gambia. The huge difference in class, the hosts' abysmal form, and the result of the first match make the visitors the overwhelming favorites.

  • Likely Outcome: A comfortable victory for Gambia.

Estonia is enduring a poor qualifying campaign, having secured just three points from six matches. Their only victory came in the away fixture against Moldova (3-2). The Estonians have lost their other five games, including a 3-1 defeat to Italy in the last round. The team currently sits fourth in the group and will be looking to end their campaign on a high note in front of their home supporters.

Moldova's form has been even worse, as they have lost all five of their matches in the current qualifying cycle. The head-to-head record favors Estonia. The 'Blueshirts' have won three of the four encounters between the sides, with one match ending in a draw. The reverse fixture in this qualifying campaign, played in March 2025, ended in a high-scoring 3-2 victory for Estonia.

Join us for the live broadcast of the final round of the 2026 FIFA World Cup African qualifiers, where Guinea will take on Botswana. For both teams, who are already out of the race for a spot in the finals from Group G, this match will be a matter of pride. The game will be played on neutral ground in Morocco, at the Stade Mohamed V in Casablanca.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 14, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Guinea enters this match in fourth place in the group with 14 points. The 'National Elephants' can no longer catch the top two teams and have thus been eliminated from World Cup contention. Despite this, the Guineans secured a comeback 2-1 victory over Mozambique in the last round, thanks to a brace from Abdoul Traore. Paulo Duarte's side will be looking to end their qualifying campaign on a high note.

Botswana is having a very poor campaign, currently sitting in fifth place in the group. 'The Zebras' have lost their last three World Cup qualifying matches, falling to Algeria (1-3), Mozambique (0-2), and Uganda (0-1). The team has significant problems with creating and converting chances, which has been the main reason for their unconvincing performance in the qualifiers.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these national teams includes six matches, with a clear advantage for Guinea: five wins to one loss. Botswana's only victory came in the first leg of the current qualifying tournament in November 2023, with a 1-0 scoreline.

Guinea vs Botswana Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider Guinea the favorites for the upcoming match. Despite the lack of tournament motivation for both teams, the superior quality of Guinea's players and their desire for revenge for the first-round defeat speak in their favor.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Guinea.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering both teams will be playing without the pressure of a result, an open game can be expected. A bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' looks appealing.
  • Key Factor: Guinea will aim to redeem themselves in front of their fans after a disappointing qualifying campaign and will seek revenge against Botswana for the only defeat in their head-to-head history.

Join us for the live broadcast of the decisive 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match as Nigeria hosts Group C leaders Benin. This encounter will determine the fate of the direct qualification spot for the World Cup, and the hosts need nothing less than a victory to secure it.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 14, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

Nigeria enters this match in third place in the group but has an excellent chance of finishing on top. The 'Super Eagles' had a poor start to the campaign but have found stability under new coach George Finidi and are unbeaten in their last seven matches. In the last round, the Nigerians secured a crucial 3-0 victory over Lesotho. At home, Nigeria has not lost a World Cup qualifier since 2021 and has won 14 of their last 19 home qualification matches. A win in this game will guarantee them a spot at the World Cup.

Benin, led by former Nigeria coach Gernot Rohr, has been the surprise package of the qualifying tournament. 'The Cheetahs' are leading the group, one point ahead of South Africa and Nigeria. The team is on a five-match unbeaten streak and secured a narrow 1-0 victory over Rwanda in their last game. A draw would be enough for Benin to qualify for their first-ever World Cup.

The head-to-head record is entirely in Nigeria's favor. The 'Super Eagles' have won all six of their previous encounters. The reverse fixture in this qualifying campaign, played in November 2023, ended in a 3-2 victory for Nigeria.

Nigeria vs Benin Prediction

Experts and bookmakers consider Nigeria the overwhelming favorites. The immense motivation, home-field advantage, superior player quality, and dominant head-to-head record make a victory for the hosts the most likely outcome.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for Nigeria.
  • Total Goals Bet: Considering that four of the last five head-to-head matches have seen three or more goals, and with a World Cup spot at stake, a bet on 'Over 2.5 goals' looks appealing.

Join us for the live broadcast of a pivotal 2026 FIFA World Cup qualification match, as South Africa hosts the leaders of Group C, Rwanda. This encounter could be decisive in the battle for a direct ticket to the World Cup.

Date and Kick-off Time: October 14, 2025, 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK).

Match Preview and Team Form

South Africa sits in second place in the group, three points behind Rwanda. 'Bafana Bafana' are in good form, remaining unbeaten in their last six matches across all competitions. In their recent qualifiers, South Africa secured victories over Benin (2-1) and Zimbabwe (3-1). Hugo Broos's side is unbeaten in their last 13 home matches, displaying solid defensive capabilities. A win in this match would allow South Africa to draw level on points with the leaders.

Rwanda is sensationally leading Group C, having collected 7 points from three matches. The 'Wasps' play pragmatic and organized football, not having conceded a single goal in the current qualifying cycle. In the first round, Rwanda caused a major upset by defeating South Africa 2-0 at home. Torsten Spittler's team is unbeaten in their last five matches, keeping a clean sheet in four of them.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these teams consists of only two official matches, with each team holding one victory. Apart from Rwanda's shock win in the current qualifiers, the teams met in 2014, when South Africa emerged victorious.

South Africa vs Rwanda Prediction

Despite Rwanda's leadership, experts and bookmakers consider South Africa the favorites for the match. Home-field advantage, superior player quality, and a desire for revenge should be the deciding factors for the hosts.

  • Likely Outcome: A victory for South Africa.
  • Total Goals Bet: Given Rwanda's solid defense and the importance of the match, a high-scoring game is unlikely. A bet on 'Under 2.5 goals' looks highly probable.
  • Key Factor: The ability of South Africa's attack to break down Rwanda's organized defense, which has yet to concede in these qualifiers.

Join us for the live broadcast of the decisive fourth-round match of the 2026 FIFA World Cup Asian qualifiers, as Qatar hosts the United Arab Emirates at the Jassim bin Hamad Stadium in Doha. This encounter will determine which team from Group A secures a direct spot at the World Cup.

Match Preview and Team Form

Qatar, the reigning AFC Asian Cup champions, enter this match needing nothing less than a victory. In their first group game, the Qataris drew 0-0 with Oman, meaning they must now defeat the UAE to qualify directly for the World Cup. Julen Lopetegui's side will have the advantage of playing at home, where they have lost only one of their last 15 World Cup qualifying matches.

The United Arab Emirates is on the verge of a historic achievement — their first appearance in a World Cup finals since 1990. In the first round, Cosmin Olăroiu's team secured a comeback 2-1 victory over Oman, thanks to goals from Marcus Meloni and Caio Lucas. Now, a draw will be enough for the UAE to clinch a direct ticket to the tournament. The team is in excellent form, having won their last four consecutive matches.

The history between these teams includes 14 matches since 2004, with a slight edge for the UAE: 6 wins to Qatar's 4, with 4 draws. The teams have already met in this qualifying campaign, with the UAE winning both encounters. However, the last six head-to-head meetings have been evenly split, with two wins for each side and two draws.

Qatar vs United Arab Emirates Prediction

Experts anticipate a tense, tactical battle, with a slight preference for the UAE given their current form and favorable position in the group. Qatar will need to attack and take risks, which could open up opportunities for their opponent's swift counter-attacks.

  • Likely Outcome: A draw or a narrow victory for the UAE.
